title: Ask HN: Which class of business model is most resilient to build in the AI era?
excerpt: > Most new businesses have some form of AI in them
content_html:
> Most new businesses have some form of AI in them

Most new business are customers of AI companies. They are consuming AI. They don't build AI. They don't advance AI technology. They are not using AI in innovative ways. They are consumers.

Don't let anyone fool you into thinking there are a bunch of new AI companies around. No. There are a few AI companies, and millions of AI customers.

Hey look, I use electricity produced by someone else. I must be in the Energy sector!?

Hey look, I stock the fridge with veggies someone else grew. I must be innovating in Agriculture!?

Hey look, my product was created by a someone else's robot. I must be innovating in AI!?

Obviously not. Any valid conversation starts by differentiating between a leading innovator, a producer and a mere consumer.
